<!-- Compute the number of downloads and Github stars for each package. -->
```{r}
library(cranlogs)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

n_downloads <- cranlogs::cran_downloads(
  packages = c("palaeoverse", "sepkoski", "rphylopic", "rmacrostrat"),
  from = "2015-01-01",
  to = Sys.Date()
) |> 
  select(count, package) |> 
  summarise(n_downloads = sum(count), .by = package) |> 
  mutate(n_downloads = paste0(round(n_downloads, digits = -3) / 1000, "k+"))

# As of July 2026, Github only allows admins of a repo to call the "stargazers" API.
# https://github.blog/changelog/2026-06-30-upcoming-access-restrictions-to-public-api-endpoints-and-ui-views/
get_stars <- function(repo) {
  fromJSON(paste0("https://api.github.com/repos/palaeoverse/", repo))$stargazers_count
}

stars <- vapply(
  c("palaeoverse", "sepkoski", "rphylopic", "rmacrostrat"),
  get_stars,
  numeric(1)
)
names(stars) <- c("palaeoverse", "sepkoski", "rphylopic", "rmacrostrat")
```

<!-- Build the cards -->
```{r}
#| output: asis

# One row per package; cards are rendered in this order.
packages <- data.frame(
  name = c("palaeoverse", "rmacrostrat", "rphylopic", "sepkoski"),
  subtitle = c(
    "Prepare and Explore Data for Palaeobiological Analyses",
    "Fetch Geologic Data from the 'Macrostrat' Platform",
    "Get Silhouettes of Organisms from PhyloPic",
    "Sepkoski's Fossil Marine Animal Genera Compendium"
  ),
  doi = c(
    "10.1111/2041-210X.14099",
    "10.1130/GES02815.1",
    "10.1111/2041-210X.14221",
    "10.5281/zenodo.7342194"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_card <- function(name, subtitle, doi) {
  n_dl <- n_downloads[n_downloads$package == name, "n_downloads"]
  sprintf('
::: {.package-card}
<a class="card-link" href="https://%1$s.palaeoverse.org/" target="_blank" aria-label="Visit %1$s website"></a>

![](../_img/hex-%1$s.png){.package-hex}

### %1$s

[%2$s]{.package-subtitle}

::: {.package-actions}
<span class="package-stars" data-repo="palaeoverse/%1$s"><i class="bi bi-star-fill"></i>%3$s</span>
&nbsp;
<span><i class="bi bi-download"></i><p>%4$s</p></span>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
<a href="https://github.com/palaeoverse/%1$s" target="_blank" class="package-repo"><i class="bi bi-github"></i></a>
:::

<br>
<div style="width: 100%%; text-align: center; z-index: 1"><a href="https://doi.org/%5$s"  target="_blank">DOI: %5$s</a></div>
:::
', name, subtitle, stars[name], n_dl, doi)
}

cat('::: {.package-grid}\n')
cards <- mapply(render_card, packages$name, packages$subtitle, packages$doi)
cat(cards, sep = "\n")
cat('\n:::\n')
```
